name: Camera station
definition: The position, height, lens and aim of the camera for one view. It sets the perspective of the room in the image: the horizon, the fall of the verticals and the shares of floor, wall and ceiling in the frame.

measures.reference: 24–35; 17–20 only in a room narrower than 2.5 m
0: the camera is level, and lens shift (not tilt) moves the frame
20 or less, unless the ceiling is the subject

measures.measure: object cut by the frame edge
measures.unit: % of the object inside the frame
measures.reference: 66 or more, or the object is out of the frame

sources.title: Julius Shulman, Photographing Architecture and Interiors (Whitney Library of Design, 1962)
Norman McGrath, Photographing Buildings Inside and Out (Whitney Library of Design, 2nd edition, 1993)
